summary: Reproduced the exact 1.421875 GiB issue-shape allocation arithmetic and confirmed that the base DSV4 paged and nonpaged paths had no logits budget. Adopted the current upstream candidate that chunks both paths by query rows under the shared DSA free-memory budget, then fixed its low-budget boundary so the chosen chunk never has an artificial 128-row floor above the budget.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence: 4096 * align(92992, 256) * 4 = 1526726656 bytes (1.421875 GiB), with a single full-row paged dispatch and no DSV4 budget/chunk helper or nonpaged chunk field.

21 tests and 25 subtests passed: issue-shape budget arithmetic, paged schedule/top-k chunk alignment, nonpaged row chunking, shared DSA behavior, below-one-row budget, exact-fit, and one-row-over boundary cases.
